```swift
    let count = 5
    
    let a: [Double] = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]
    let b: [Double] = [ 1,  2,  3,  4,  5]
    
    let c = [Double](unsafeUninitializedCapacity: count) {
        buffer, initializedCount in
        
        vDSP.multiply(a, b,
                      result: &buffer)
        
        initializedCount = count
    }
    
    // Prints "[10.0, 40.0, 90.0, 160.0, 250.0]".
    print(c)
```
